html:
How MeCard works

A live digital business card in 60 seconds — for one person or a whole team. Share by NFC tap, QR, or link. Add physical cards whenever you want.

Pick your starting point

Whether you’re a solo professional or rolling MeCard out across a team, the underlying product is the same. The path you take to get there isn’t.

If it’s just you

Freelancers, small-business owners, sales people who network in their own name.

1. Sign up free

Sign in with Google or use your email. Name and photo come from your Google account.

2. Build your profile

Job title, company, mobile, LinkedIn. Your live profile appears at mecard.co.za/mecard-profile/your-name.

3. Share any way

QR code, WhatsApp, native share, copy link, email or SMS. One tap and they have your contact.

4. Add a card later

Order an NFC card from inside your console — Classic R299 or Custom R399. Tap-to-share a profile that’s already live.

Start free for me

If you’re rolling it out to a team

HR teams, marketing departments, sales managers, agencies giving every client’s rep a card.

1. Set up your business account

Sign up as the admin. The teams console lives at /manage-mecard-profiles/ — one place to run everyone’s profile.

2. Add your people — or hand us a list

Add team members one by one from the console, or send us a CSV and we’ll bulk-load them for you. Each person gets their own profile under the company brand.

3. Apply your brand

Company logo, colours, layout. Set it once at the company level and it carries across every profile.

4. Order cards in bulk

Classic at R299 each or Custom at R399 each, printed with your design. Order from inside the console — one basket, one delivery.

See the team setup

What every profile can do

Whether you’re running one MeCard or 200, every profile shares the same set of tools.

QR code

Generated on demand. Download as a PNG to print on a poster, slide, or window decal.

WhatsApp deep-link

Type a phone number, hit send, the recipient gets your profile in their WhatsApp chat.

NFC tap

Tap your card or phone tag on someone’s phone. Their browser opens your profile.

vCard download

One tap on the profile saves your contact straight into the recipient’s phone book.

Always one tap away

MeCard installs to your phone’s home screen like an app — without an app store. Open it, share, done.

On iPhone, the install instructions appear after signup. On Android, it’s a one-tap browser prompt.
